notes.title: Raging Loop is Now Available in English!
notes.content:
[h1]We’re happy to announce that Raging Loop is now available in English for all to play!  Enjoy a 10% discount from today through to December 15th![/h1]

In this psychological horror story, play as Fusaishi Haruaki, a graduate student lost in the middle of nowhere after a convenient bike crash. Haruaki must rely on the hospitality of nearby villagers living in a small and remote settlement nearby – but little does he know that they are about to engage in a deadly and ominous ritual.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30435559/e0192d66036ad2eac092fbbe74cf2703857b06f0.png[/img]

Every night, a villager inhabited by a godly creature will leave a corpse behind. In an attempt to protect themselves, the townsfolks will vote for one person to be hanged.
 
Help Haruaki escape the village alive!
